answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining the shared market: the stake acts as a mirror of past behavior, since a sybil that misbehaves loses its bond. Verification flows through a single inlet of attestations, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents keep theirs. At the nadir of trust, after a detected attack, the bond is slashed automatically, making large-scale fakery economically ruinous rather than merely inconvenient.
